pages.text: The Electric Pump extracts water from the source directly below it. In this Horizon alpha, it works only with an infinite water source: the source block needs at least two horizontal neighboring water sources. A finite water source is left untouched because the pinned Horizon hooks do not allow a machine to remove a world block.

The pump uses 10 FE/t and fills the 16,000 mB tank by 1,000 mB every 20 ticks. Supply FE and connect a Fluid Conduit to draw out the water. Right-click the pump to see source, cycle, tank, and energy status. Ocean and beach water is not converted to Seawater in this alpha.
